verses.original: Οὕτως ἄνθρωπος λογιζέσθω ἡμᾶς ὡς ὑπηρέτας Χριστοῦ καὶ οἰκονόμους μυστηρίων Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Houtōs anthrōpos logizesthō hēmas hōs hypēretas Christou kai oikonomous mystēriōn Theou
verses.literal: So then men ought to regard us as servants of Christ and stewards of the mysteries of God

verses.original: ὧδε λοιπὸν ζητεῖται τοῖς οἰκονόμοις ἐν τις ἵνα εὑρεθῇ πιστός
verses.transliteration: hōde loipon zēteitai tois oikonomois en tis hina heurethē pistos
verses.literal: Now . . . it is required - of stewards - - that they be found faithful

verses.original: Ἐμοὶ ἐστιν ἐλάχιστόν δὲ εἰς ἵνα ἀνακριθῶ ὑφ’ ὑμῶν ἢ ὑπὸ ἀνθρωπίνης ἡμέρας ἀλλ’ οὐδὲ ἀνακρίνω ἐμαυτὸν
verses.transliteration: Emoi estin elachiston de eis hina anakrithō hyph’ hymōn ē hypo anthrōpinēs hēmeras all’ oude anakrinō emauton
verses.literal: I care very little . . . however - if I am judged by you or by any human court In fact vvv I do not even judge myself

verses.original: γὰρ σύνοιδα οὐδὲν ἐμαυτῷ ἀλλ’ ἐν τούτῳ οὐκ δεδικαίωμαι δὲ ἐστιν Κύριός ὁ ἀνακρίνων με
verses.transliteration: gar synoida ouden emautō all’ en toutō ouk dedikaiōmai de estin Kyrios ho anakrinōn me
verses.literal: - My conscience is clear . . . . . . but - that vvv does not vindicate me - It is [the] Lord who judges me

verses.original: Ὥστε κρίνετε μὴ τι πρὸ καιροῦ ἕως ὁ Κύριος ἂν ἔλθῃ ὃς καὶ φωτίσει τὰ κρυπτὰ τοῦ σκότους καὶ φανερώσει τὰς βουλὰς τῶν καρδιῶν καὶ τότε ἑκάστῳ γενήσεται ὁ ἔπαινος ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hōste krinete mē ti pro kairou heōs ho Kyrios an elthē hos kai phōtisei ta krypta tou skotous kai phanerōsei tas boulas tōn kardiōn kai tote hekastō genēsetai ho epainos apo tou Theou
verses.literal: Therefore judge vvv nothing before [the] appointed time [wait] until the Lord - comes [He] - will bring to light what is hidden - in darkness and will expose the motives of [ men’s ] hearts - At that time each will receive [his] praise from - God

verses.original: δέ ἀδελφοί μετεσχημάτισα Ταῦτα εἰς ἐμαυτὸν καὶ Ἀπολλῶν δι’ ὑμᾶς ἵνα μάθητε ἐν ἡμῖν τό Μὴ ὑπὲρ ἃ γέγραπται ἵνα μὴ εἷς φυσιοῦσθε ὑπὲρ τοῦ ἑνὸς κατὰ τοῦ ἑτέρου
verses.transliteration: de adelphoi meteschēmatisa Tauta eis emauton kai Apollōn di’ hymas hina mathēte en hēmin to Mē hyper ha gegraptai hina mē heis physiousthe hyper tou henos kata tou heterou
verses.literal: - Brothers I have applied these things to myself and Apollos for your benefit . . . so that you may learn from us - not [to go] beyond what is written Then vvv vvv you will not take pride in - one [man] over vvv another

verses.original: γάρ τίς διακρίνει σε δὲ τί ἔχεις ὃ οὐκ ἔλαβες δὲ εἰ καὶ ἔλαβες τί καυχᾶσαι ὡς μὴ λαβών
verses.transliteration: gar tis diakrinei se de ti echeis ho ouk elabes de ei kai elabes ti kauchasai hōs mē labōn
verses.literal: For who makes you so superior . . . - What do you have that vvv you did not receive And if vvv you did receive [it] why do you boast as though vvv [you did not]

verses.original: ἤδη ἐστέ κεκορεσμένοι ἤδη ἐπλουτήσατε χωρὶς ἡμῶν ἐβασιλεύσατε καὶ ὄφελόν γε ἐβασιλεύσατε ἵνα ἡμεῖς καὶ συμβασιλεύσωμεν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Ēdē este kekoresmenoi ēdē eploutēsate chōris hēmōn ebasileusate kai ophelon ge ebasileusate hina hēmeis kai symbasileusōmen hymin
verses.literal: Already vvv you have all you want Already you have become rich Without us you have become kings - How I wish vvv you really were kings so that we - might be kings with you

verses.original: γάρ δοκῶ ὁ Θεὸς ἀπέδειξεν ἡμᾶς τοὺς ἀποστόλους ἐσχάτους ὡς ἐπιθανατίους ὅτι ἐγενήθημεν θέατρον τῷ κόσμῳ καὶ ἀγγέλοις καὶ ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: gar dokō ho Theos apedeixen hēmas tous apostolous eschatous hōs epithanatious hoti egenēthēmen theatron tō kosmō kai angelois kai anthrōpois
verses.literal: For it seems to me that God has displayed us - apostles at the end [ of the procession ] like [ prisoners ] appointed for death - We have become a spectacle to the whole world - to angels as well as to men

verses.original: Ἡμεῖς μωροὶ διὰ Χριστόν δὲ ὑμεῖς φρόνιμοι ἐν Χριστῷ ἡμεῖς ἀσθενεῖς δὲ ὑμεῖς ἰσχυροί ὑμεῖς ἔνδοξοι δὲ ἡμεῖς ἄτιμοι
verses.transliteration: Hēmeis mōroi dia Christon de hymeis phronimoi en Christō hēmeis astheneis de hymeis ischyroi hymeis endoxoi de hēmeis atimoi
verses.literal: We [are] fools for Christ but you [are] wise in Christ We [are] weak but you [are] strong You [are] honored but we [are] dishonored

verses.original: ἄχρι τῆς ἄρτι ὥρας καὶ πεινῶμεν καὶ διψῶμεν καὶ γυμνιτεύομεν καὶ κολαφιζόμεθα καὶ ἀστατοῦμεν
verses.transliteration: achri tēs arti hōras kai peinōmen kai dipsōmen kai gymniteuomen kai kolaphizometha kai astatoumen
verses.literal: To [this] very hour - we are hungry and thirsty - we are poorly clothed - we are brutally treated - we are homeless

verses.original: καὶ κοπιῶμεν ἐργαζόμενοι ταῖς ἰδίαις χερσίν λοιδορούμενοι εὐλογοῦμεν διωκόμενοι ἀνεχόμεθα
verses.transliteration: kai kopiōmen ergazomenoi tais idiais chersin loidoroumenoi eulogoumen diōkomenoi anechometha
verses.literal: - We work hard . . . with [our] own hands When we are vilified we bless when we are persecuted we endure [it]

verses.original: δυσφημούμενοι παρακαλοῦμεν ἕως ἄρτι ἐγενήθημεν ὡς περικαθάρματα τοῦ κόσμου περίψημα πάντων
verses.transliteration: dysphēmoumenoi parakaloumen heōs arti egenēthēmen hōs perikatharmata tou kosmou peripsēma pantōn
verses.literal: when we are slandered we answer gently Up to this moment we have become - [the] scum of the earth [the] refuse of [the world]

verses.original: Οὐκ γράφω ταῦτα ἐντρέπων ὑμᾶς ἀλλ’ νουθετῶν ὡς μου ἀγαπητὰ τέκνα
verses.transliteration: Ouk graphō tauta entrepōn hymas all’ nouthetōn hōs mou agapēta tekna
verses.literal: vvv I am not writing this to shame you but to warn you as my beloved children

verses.original: γὰρ ἐὰν ἔχητε μυρίους παιδαγωγοὺς ἐν Χριστῷ ἀλλ’ οὐ πολλοὺς πατέρας γὰρ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ἐγὼ ἐγέννησα ὑμᾶς διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.transliteration: gar ean echēte myrious paidagōgous en Christō all’ ou pollous pateras gar en Christō Iēsou egō egennēsa hymas dia tou euangeliou
verses.literal: Even if you have ten thousand guardians in Christ - [you do] not [have] many fathers for in Christ Jesus I became your father . . . through the gospel

verses.original: οὖν παρακαλῶ ὑμᾶς γίνεσθε μιμηταί μου
verses.transliteration: oun parakalō hymas ginesthe mimētai mou
verses.literal: Therefore I urge you vvv to imitate me

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο αὐτὸ ἔπεμψα ὑμῖν Τιμόθεον ὅς ἐστίν μου ἀγαπητὸν καὶ πιστὸν τέκνον ἐν Κυρίῳ ὃς ἀναμνήσει ὑμᾶς μου τὰς ὁδούς τὰς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ καθὼς διδάσκω πανταχοῦ ἐν πάσῃ ἐκκλησίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Dia touto auto epempsa hymin Timotheon hos estin mou agapēton kai piston teknon en Kyriō hos anamnēsei hymas mou tas hodous tas en Christō Iēsou kathōs didaskō pantachou en pasē ekklēsia
verses.literal: That is why . . . . . . I have sent you Timothy - - my beloved and faithful child in [the] Lord [He] will remind you of my - way of life - in Christ Jesus which is exactly what I teach everywhere in every church

verses.original: τινες ἐφυσιώθησάν Ὡς μου μὴ ἐρχομένου δέ πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: tines ephysiōthēsan Hōs mou mē erchomenou de pros hymas
verses.literal: Some [of you] have become arrogant as if I vvv were not coming - to you

verses.original: δὲ ἐλεύσομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς ταχέως ἐὰν ὁ Κύριος θελήσῃ καὶ γνώσομαι οὐ τὸν τῶν πεφυσιωμένων λόγον ἀλλὰ τὴν δύναμιν
verses.transliteration: de eleusomai pros hymas tacheōs ean ho Kyrios thelēsē kai gnōsomai ou ton tōn pephysiōmenōn logon alla tēn dynamin
verses.literal: But I will come to you shortly if the Lord is willing and [then] I will find out not [only] what these arrogant [people] are saying but what power [they have]

verses.original: γὰρ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐ ἐν λόγῳ ἀλλ’ ἐν δυνάμει
verses.transliteration: gar hē basileia tou Theou ou en logō all’ en dynamei
verses.literal: For the kingdom - of God [is] not a matter of talk but of power

verses.original: τί θέλετε ἔλθω πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν ῥάβδῳ ἢ ἐν ἀγάπῃ τε πραΰτητος πνεύματί
verses.transliteration: ti thelete elthō pros hymas en rhabdō ē en agapē te prautētos pneumati
verses.literal: Which do you prefer Shall I come to you with a rod or in love and [with] a gentle spirit
